episode.subject: Inca tern pair on a rocky ledge
episode.title: Both feet on the rock
episode.body:
He put one foot on my back. I waited for the other. Then all the flapping began.

I looked round.

He was concentrating so hard that I kept still. Even when the tip of his wing brushed my face.

Afterward he stood beside me with both feet on the rock. I leaned into him. He wobbled again.
